name: Scalar Field Normalization
aliases: Scalar Field Normalization for Color Mapping
Scalar Field Normalization — Min-Max Normalization, Global Min-Max Scaling
definition: Scales scalar field data to the range [0, 1] based on the global minimum and maximum values.
summary: Scalar Field Normalization linearly maps volume intensities to a standard range using global extrema, distinguishing itself by preserving linear relationships unlike non-linear methods.
